scope: Six individually computed own elastic reference inputs, in copy; no app activation or resistance release.
geometry_family: Own rounded/faceted R01 209 nodes, ri=t; not all properties of the printed catalogue.
control_120: Separate frozen reference preserved, not included or scaled in this six-profile registry.
signature_scope: Only the 30 individually reviewed valleys are consolidated. Long-wave samples or unreviewed grid points are not qualified by this registry.

property_convention.area: dA=t ds along the same faceted open midsurface
property_convention.inertia: Exact segment line integrals; finite-through-thickness inertia terms omitted
property_convention.J: Saint-Venant thin-wall approximation integral(t^3 ds)/3, not exact finite-thickness torsion
property_convention.Cw: Vlasov line-sectorial integral normalized orthogonal to 1,x,y
property_convention.x0: CGx-CTx, positive from CT toward the lips
property_convention.signs: Own coordinate convention only; no sign assigned to historical Pierin Mly.

strong_local.interpretation: Own continuous-half-wave signature valley, conventional mode of the frozen section and declared pure bending state. Not an exact eigenvalue for every finite span.

strong_distortional.interpretation: Own continuous-half-wave signature valley, conventional mode of the frozen section and declared pure bending state. Not an exact eigenvalue for every finite span.

web_local.interpretation: Own continuous-half-wave signature valley, conventional mode of the frozen section and declared pure bending state. Not an exact eigenvalue for every finite span.

lips_local.interpretation: Own continuous-half-wave signature valley, conventional mode of the frozen section and declared pure bending state. Not an exact eigenvalue for every finite span.

lips_distortional.interpretation: Own continuous-half-wave signature valley, conventional mode of the frozen section and declared pure bending state. Not an exact eigenvalue for every finite span.

weak_web_distortional.interpretation: Certified conservative lower bound for every admissible conventional discrete eigenvalue; not identification or absence of a D mode.

supports_and_actions: Ideal fork supports at both ends; warping free.
Kx=Ky=Kz=Cb=Cm=1 and Lx=Ly=Lz=L.
No intermediate restraints or roof/panel contribution.
Centroidal pure bending resultants; zero axial prestress and no imposed primary torque.
External transverse forces, if used later, require shear-centre loading or separate load-height/eccentricity justification.
No approval of torsion, restrained warping, actual connection stiffness, member resistance, interactions, or ELS.
profiles.Pierin_usage: Nominal family selection only. No critical, radius, historical sign or material inferred from Pierin.
